_note: Russian and English renderings of the Kyrgyz questions in questions.jsonl, used to test whether translating a Kyrgyz question before searching improves retrieval. Translated by the assistant in-session, the same way the 1,100 article translations were made. These are good translations by design: they measure the ceiling of the approach, not what a cheap runtime translator would produce.
